name: Build Hooks for Github
ecosystem_note: Submodule of build_hooks. Adds one FrontendEnvironment plugin ('github') that triggers a GitHub workflow/dispatch by POSTing to a per-environment build-hook URL (typically a GitHub API dispatches endpoint) with body {"ref":"<branch>"} and an Authorization: token <PAT> header. The personal access token is a single site-wide value in build_hooks_github.settings.github_access_token. No manager/service and no recent-builds table (unlike bitbucket/circleci/netlify). Secret: the PAT is stored plaintext in config and rendered into the settings form textfield — see security.md.
